statement: On the held-out-from-export set, the sign right after G55 (twelve strokes) is a closing sign more often than the sign right after the other stacked-stroke numerals (G13-G19, G27-G29).
basis: results/g55_scouting.md (exploration: G55 36% vs 0-16%); pre-run count on the new set only: G55 16 uses, other stacked numerals 47 (counts only, no neighbours looked at).
data: icit_new_to_export, incomplete texts kept, deduplicated by sign sequence; abroad sites included (no site filter).
roles: frozen rule of scripts/functional_skeleton.py assign() learned on complete exploration texts of indus_website (as in g55_scouting.py); closer = role 2. A token at the text end has no next sign and is left out.
statistic: share(next sign is closer | G55) minus share(next sign is closer | other stacked numeral)
null: G55 / other labels shuffled across the scored stacked-numeral tokens
secondary: same with 'next sign is a middle (content) sign', expected lower for G55 (reported, not the verdict)
